commit: fix(config): pass the directory of the file to lilconfig.search()

truth.description: loadPrettierConfig now searches from the parent folder of any path it gets and keeps the working-directory search only for a missing path, but formatStdin still passes process.cwd() to getOptionsForFile when no --stdin-filepath is given, so that branch never runs for the CLI and formatting from stdin skips the .prettierrc in the working directory.

distractions.why: resolveConfigFile only uses the folder that holds the path it gets, so the test can name a file that does not exist in directory/ and still finds directory/.prettierrc as the expected result.
